findings: The existing validator independently accepted the retained finite migration, Core/resource, native, PGO and raw-sample evidence at the exact final source.
HIA batch median is lower than the four C/C++ arms in this run and higher than all three Rust arms. Tail and whole-process measurements do not show uniform HIA superiority.
There are no byte-identical complete images, complete .text sections or complete six-service byte sets among the eight arms; some individual C/C++ service functions are exact duplicates.
All 18 HIA exports are resource-qualified, but only the six service wrappers share the declared sentinel error ABI. Extra raw/helper symbols remain public.
The 67032 KiB repeated process maximum cannot support a module-only memory comparison; execution history and launch footprint are not isolated.

NDU consumes real archived STB timing/load/image measurements in pairwise finite models, with fresh real controller execution but no new strategy-driven STB delivery experiment. Image bytes and zero unload time remain assumptions.
No whole-program translation/backend theorem, universal performance advantage, NDU independent net benefit or full-cost RSI gain follows from this review.

memory_and_image_limits.image_scope: ELF file bytes include sections, symbol/string metadata and alignment, with unequal public-export sets and dynamic dependencies. PT_LOAD memsz is virtual image accounting, not RSS. Dependency footprints are not included in file size.
memory_and_image_limits.inference: The identical 67032 KiB values are consistent with a shared inherited/launch high-water floor; evidence does not identify the exact contributing phase.
memory_and_image_limits.launcher_method: Linux run_bounded uses Python subprocess.Popen with start_new_session=True and cwd; inspected CPython excludes posix_spawn under these conditions and uses fork_exec; no fork-versus-vfork trace was collected.
memory_and_image_limits.observation_method: driver.c getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss after the whole loaded request loop
